title: Check if a business holds Authorised Economic Operator status
text:
Authorised Economic Operator status is an internationally recognised standard that shows a business’s role in the international supply chain is secure, and that it has customs control procedures that meet Authorised Economic Operator standards and criteria.

 This list is in alphabetical order.
changeNote: The list of approved Authorised Economic Operator businesses has been updated.
